system.description:
You may use this skill if your subclass is Artificer, Sigilmancer, Alchemist, Wand Master, or Machinist.

You receive one basic item with the [Magic Stone] or [Magic] tag whose IR is less than [CR - 2 (at least 1)]. 

(SR2): You can receive an item with an IR up to your CR.

(Connection: Craftsman, Collector, Magician): The fate cost is 0 instead of 1.

A special skill that puts magical power into various tools and creates special magic tools.
